phase_definition.draw_ms: surface setup, background paint, clip calculation and doc->draw
phase_definition.convert_ms: surface flush, data/stride access, RGBA vector allocation and straight-alpha conversion
phase_definition.write_close_ms: ofstream open/write and implicit close (page-cache completion, no fsync); excludes RGBA destruction
phase_definition.total_ms: production DRAW clock to after surface destroy/status check; before JSON/FRAME reporting
phase_definition.residual: cairo context destruction, output path decode, RGBA destruction, surface destruction/status check and timestamp overhead
